answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the nebula of a task receipt, and the karst is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The relic of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
